Subject: Deployment mode & migration next steps

Hi Emily — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we heard
- Current setup: prototyping with OpenAI plus a small legacy GPU cluster used for internal experiments.
- Main drivers: cost predictability, data residency for PHI-sensitive flows, and lower per-token unit economics at scale.
- Target constraints: sub-250ms deviation for chat latency, ~50 concurrent requests at peaks, and desire for private network controls for PHI over the next 6–12 months.

Deployment options we discussed
- Hosted API: fastest route (no infra), good for early workloads, but limited for strict PHI/regulatory requirements.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools we manage for you — predictable throughput, isolation, and easier migration from OpenAI with minimal client-side changes.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full customer-managed networking, KMS/HSM options, and audit controls for regulated workloads — longer lead time.

Suggested next steps
1) Technical migration workshop (Rishi to lead) — review current API usage, payload sizes, model variants, and throughput patterns.
2) Pilot recommendation: start with Dedicated for an initial migration (3–8 week pilot) to validate latency & cost, then evaluate Private for production if you need VPC/HSM.
3) We’ll follow up with a short Mutual Action Plan + capacity worksheet (attached) and the SOC 2 + HIPAA addenda examples for legal review.

Attachments: deployment_mode_comparison.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Availability: are you free for a 60–90 min workshop next Tue/Wed morning PT?

Thanks — excited to help you pick the right path and make migration low-risk.
\u2014

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side after chatting with the infra team: 

- Compliance: we process PHI and will need HIPAA protections and a BAA in place before moving any production traffic. SOC 2 Type II evidence + BAA are mandatory.
- Current usage: roughly 5M tokens/month currently on OpenAI, with short bursts up to ~70 reqs/sec during business hours (peaks). Typical payloads average 1–2k tokens per call (few long-context cases).
- Latency: target p95 end-to-end under 400ms (we understand some variance), but prefer sub-250ms for our chat experience.
- Preference: leaning toward Private (VPC) for long-term production due to data residency + KMS needs. However, the team wants to evaluate Dedicated if the migration effort is significantly lower and we can satisfy BAA/SLA requirements.

Requests:
1) Can you share a sample SOC 2 report and a draft BAA and HIPAA addenda?
2) High-level migration plan: timelines, steps, and resource expectations for Dedicated vs Private.
3) Rough cost comparison for our current usage profile (5M tokens/mo + 70 reqs/sec peak).

I’m available for the workshop Tue 7/14 9–11am PT or Wed 7/15 8–10am PT.

Best,
Emily

Hi Emily — Rishi here (solutions engineering). Short technical note ahead of the workshop: 

Recommendation at a glance
- Pilot path: Dedicated pool for the initial migration. Low client-side changes (same REST/SDK calls), we handle model orchestration and autoscaling. This lets you validate latency/cost quickly while we scope Private.
- Production path: Private (VPC) if you need customer-managed networking, HSM/KMS integration, and full audit logs for PHI. Private is more operationally involved (network setup, firewall rules, and on-prem options if required).

What I need from you for accurate sizing/costs
- Typical request concurrency and average and 95th-percentile token counts (sample logs if possible).
- Example prompt+response payloads (anonymized) or a short trace so we can estimate KV cache hit rates and batching benefits.
- Any model family preferences (e.g., Llama 2-70B, Mistral, or others) — model choice materially changes GPU and throughput profiles.

Migration outline (high level)
1) Discovery & capacity sizing (1 week) — share logs, sample payloads, and target SLOs.
2) Pilot on Dedicated (2–4 weeks) — ingest traffic, tune batching/quantization, validate latency.
3) If moving to Private: network & compliance setup (2–6 weeks) — VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration, legal signoffs, on-prem coordination if needed.

I attached a capacity_plan_template.csv to help capture the details. If you can drop a couple of sample traces before the workshop, I’ll prepare a sizing recommendation and a cost delta for Dedicated vs Private.
